verdict.rationale: Open-source availability is a fair question for an agent identity and payments platform, so the axis applies. The pack only shows that the KYAPay token format is an open specification and that marketing calls Skyfire an "open identity and payments layer". Neither shows a public source repository or an open license for Skyfire's own code, and the open token format is an adjacent openness claim, not readable source.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
